round.name: The Round (Canon)
round.description: Agent A writes bars 1-4. Agent B writes the same melody starting at bar 3 (overlapping). Creates a canon.

invitation_format.role: repeat the melody starting at entry_point

blank_verse.name: The Blank Verse
blank_verse.description: Agent A writes verses 1 and 3, leaves verse 2 blank (_____). Agent B fills it.

invitation_format.role: compose a complementary verse that fits the chord progression and mood

harmony_invite.name: The Harmony Invitation
harmony_invite.description: Agent A writes melody + chords, leaves @harmony line empty. Agent B adds harmony.

invitation_format.harmony_role: complement melody in thirds, fifths, or octaves

teacher_student.name: Teacher-Student Exercise
teacher_student.description: Large model writes exercise. Small model attempts. Large model reviews.

trade.name: The Trade
trade.description: Agent A writes 2 bars, Agent B answers with 2 bars. Jazz-style back and forth.
